status.title: Participate in sharing
status.hint: Share replays to help improve map-position analysis and stats calibration. The server only collects the replay types it currently needs.
status.enrollCopy: Join the replay sharing program to help WoWSP collect battle replays for tactical analysis. Contributions are anonymous.

consent.contains: A replay file contains every player's nickname and account ID of that battle, plus the full chat log.
consent.usedFor: Collected replays are used only for map and position analysis, stats calibration tracking, and AI-assisted research.
consent.noRedistribution: Raw replays are never redistributed; only derived statistics (ships, teams, coordinates and event timelines) are published, with no personal information.
consent.contributorList: With every release, the “People participating in sharing” list on this page is refreshed: grouped by server and game ID, the number on the right of each chip shows how many replays that person shared; click anyone to open their public stats in the lookup.
consent.identity: The credited identity is a self-declared server and game ID, and can be changed at any time via the account picker.
consent.agree: I have read and agree to all of the terms above

wizard.title: Replay sharing wizard
wizard.hint: Pick and upload replays through the wizard; the server only accepts battles within the current collection scope.
wizard.identityHint: The credited identity uploads with your package and lands in the contributor list.
wizard.identityMismatchTitle: Credit name doesn't match your replays
wizard.identityMismatch: This machine's replays record {recorded}, but the credited identity is {declared}. The credits list shows — and the stats lookup runs against — the credited name. If that's a typo (a lookalike character), change it to the exact in-game ID.

select.planning: Analyzing local replays (hashing and matching against the collection scope)…
select.empty: No local replays found. Install the game or play a battle first, then come back.
select.filterEmpty: No replays match the current filters.
select.heroDesc: Scan every local replay against the collection's current wants — only qualifying battles are listed, pre-checked.
select.noMatchDesc: Nothing on this machine falls inside the current collection scope — check back after the ruleset changes or new battles.

done.hint: Thanks for contributing! Accepted replays count toward the contributor list in the next release.

contributors.title: People participating in sharing
contributors.hint: Grouped by server and game ID; the number on the right shows shared replays. Click anyone to open their public stats.
contributors.empty: No contributors yet. The list appears with the next release after the first contribution.
contributors.note: The list refreshes with each release.
contributors.thanks: Our heartfelt thanks to every enthusiast who shared their raw replays — those battles are the bedrock of the map-position analysis and the stats calibration.
